autoExec.autoRepairAria: Toggle whether to auto repair after review
autoExec.autoRepairDesc: Only applies when auto review is on; when off, issues are kept for you to handle manually or rerun.
autoExec.autoReviewAria: Toggle whether to auto review after main text is generated
autoExec.autoReviewDesc: When off, the chapter ends as soon as the main text is generated, and quality checks are left for you to handle manually.
autoExec.autoReviewTitle: Auto review after main text is generated
autoExec.maxChapterHint: No more than the {{count}} chapters in the whole-book plan.
autoExec.newBook.bookDescription: Best for letting the AI cover the entire book from planning to main-text execution.
autoExec.newBook.chapterRangeDescription: Best for producing opening sample chapters first; defaults to chapters 1-10 and can be adjusted to the book's chapter count.
autoExec.newBook.volumeDescription: Best for letting the AI finish the first volume's chapter breakdown, writing, review, and repair first.
autoExec.qualityStrategyNote: The system will automatically prepare the beat sheet, chapter breakdown, and chapter execution resources for the scope you selected, then continue writing. Current quality strategy: {{strategy}}.
autoExec.reviewAutoRepair: Auto review + auto repair after main text
autoExec.reviewNoRepair: Auto review after main text, no auto repair
autoExec.reviewNone: No auto review or repair after main text
autoExec.takeover.bookDescription: Best for letting the AI re-validate the whole-book plan and continue across the entire book.
autoExec.takeover.chapterRangeDescriptio: Best for letting the AI take over just one segment, such as chapters 11-20.
autoExec.takeover.volumeDescription: Best for letting the AI take over a specified volume and its chapters.
basicInfo.advancedDesc: This part affects later generation style and the degree of AI automation, but it is not something a newcomer must decide on the first screen.
basicInfo.advancedTitle: Narrative experience and AI collaboration advanced settings
basicInfo.aiCollaborationDesc: This part defines how you and the AI divide the work, and how far the system can auto-progress afterward.
basicInfo.continuationAnalysisSectionMis: The book-analysis result must be paired with the analysis chapters to inject.
basicInfo.continuationSourceDesc: Continuation mode requires a clear upstream source first, so it is expanded by default.
basicInfo.continuationSourceMissing: In continuation mode you must first choose a clear upstream source before you can save the basic info.
basicInfo.defaultChapterLengthHint: Recommended to start at 2500-3500; you can still adjust per chapter later.
basicInfo.estimatedChapterCountHint: Used as a reference for the outline, beats, and pipeline default range; still adjustable later.
basicInfo.genrePlaceholder: Do not set a genre base for now
basicInfo.genreVsProgressionDesc: The genre base answers "what kind of book is this", e.g. cultivation, urban, alternate history; the progression mode answers "what keeps this book advancing and paying off", e.g. system, invincible, or farming progression.
basicInfo.genreVsProgressionTitle: Difference between genre base and progression mode
basicInfo.narrativeExperienceDesc: These fields define how readers perceive this work and directly affect the tone, density, and progression of chapter planning.
basicInfo.oneLineSummaryPlaceholder: Use 2-4 sentences to explain the protagonist, core conflict, and story hooks.
basicInfo.positioningDesc: First write out the title, one-line summary, target readers, core selling point, and the first-30-chapters promise, then add the creative mode, genre, and progression approach; these directly affect later mainline planning, volume/chapter progression, and main-text generation.
basicInfo.postGenStyleReviewDesc: When on, after a chapter's main text is generated the system checks for AI-flavor risk and generates a revised draft when fixable issues are found.
basicInfo.primaryStoryModePlaceholder: Do not set a primary progression mode for now
basicInfo.productionStatusDesc: These statuses mainly serve project management and later flow decisions; they are not set once and for all and can be adjusted by stage.
basicInfo.projectStatusDesc: These mainly serve project management and flow decisions and are not something you must handle immediately on the first screen.
basicInfo.referenceWorldSampleDesc: This is only for recording an initialization reference. For full import, generation, and sync, go to "This Book's World" in the novel workspace after creation.
basicInfo.resourceReadyScoreHint: 0 means just starting; 100 means the setup, characters, and planning are fairly complete.
basicInfo.secondaryStoryModePlaceholder: Do not add a secondary progression mode
basicInfo.worldPlaceholder: Do not specify a reference sample
candidateBatches.adjustDirectionPlacehol: e.g. Keep this one, but make the protagonist more proactive.
candidateBatches.emptyHint: Give the AI a line of inspiration first, and it will produce the first batch of whole-book direction candidates.
candidateBatches.fallbackTitleReason: Keeps the title from the current director candidate plan.
candidateBatches.noSuitableHint: Pick a few correction directions, then add a line about the feel you want. The system keeps the previous round and generates a new batch of plans.
candidateBatches.redoTitlePlaceholder: e.g. More urban and cold, not like an old-style power-up story.
candidateBatches.refineFeedbackPlacehold: e.g. I want a stronger female-oriented growth feel, not too much like pure romance, and not too dark.
candidateBatches.titleAsDirection: Can be used directly as the title for this direction.
characterFocus.primaryLineProtagonistFal: Protagonist goal to be filled in
characterFocus.primaryLineSupportingFall: Relationship to protagonist to be filled in
factDebug.card.activeRuntimeBadge: The backend is touching this step right now
factDebug.card.canContinueNo: Must fill in prerequisite facts first
factDebug.card.latestFactLabel: Latest fact description for this step
factDebug.card.nextStepLabel: Next step judged by the system
factDebug.currentFactTitle: The system will fill in this part first
factDebug.dialogDescription: This shows each step's check result based on real output. You can see directly which steps already have results, which lack prerequisites, and which the system is preparing to fill in first.
factDebug.empty: There is no director task to check yet. Start or take over an AI director flow first, and step-by-step check results will appear here.
factDebug.inspectWarning: Some steps' checks did not return complete results. This is usually because the current task state is incomplete, or this part needs more fact sources.
factDebug.loading: Reading the completeness check result of the current director chain...
factDebug.nextAction.none: No extra action suggested right now
factDebug.nextAction.runChapterDetail: Continue refining the remaining chapter task list
factDebug.nextAction.runChapterList: Continue completing the volume chapter breakdown list
factDebug.rejudging: The system is re-judging the next step
factDebug.resumeFrom.beatSheet: Continue from the volume beat sheet
factDebug.resumeFrom.chapterDetailBundle: Continue from the remaining unrefined chapters
factDebug.resumeFrom.chapterList: Continue from the volume chapter breakdown list
factDebug.summary.blockedDetail: Upstream facts are not ready, so this step cannot start yet.
factDebug.summary.currentDetail: This is the next main processing step the system judged from existing facts.
factDebug.summary.doneDetail: The system has found the real output for this step and can reuse it directly.
factDebug.summary.workingDetail: This step already meets execution conditions, but the facts are not fully closed out.
ideaInspiration.hint: These are just temporary ideas; you can keep editing after using them.
progress.currentActionWaitingTitleRepair: Chapter list generated, waiting to repair title structure
progress.descCandidateFailed: The candidate-direction generation chain was interrupted; you can view execution details first, then decide whether to retry.
progress.descCandidateRunning: The system will first organize the project setup and align book-level framing, then generate two book-level plans and their title groups.
progress.descChapterTitleWarning: The chapter list is preserved; this is a structural reminder you can handle directly. You can quickly fix the titles, then decide whether to continue the later director flow.
progress.descDefault: You can leave this page and the task keeps running; when you return you can check progress in the AI cockpit.
progress.descFailed: The task stopped at the latest step; you can view execution details first, then decide whether to recover.
progress.descWaitingApproval: The director flow is stopped at a review point; you can check the outputs first, then decide whether to continue auto-progressing.
progress.emptyMilestone: The task is created and waiting for the first stable milestone to be written.
progress.emptyProgress: Progress records will be written here after the task runs.
progress.failureFallback: The director task failed, but no clear error was recorded.
progress.styleSummaryLabel: Writing-style summary effective only in this stage
takeoverEntry.note: Before taking over, the system reads the project's real progress and tells you clearly which steps it will skip, continue, or rerun this time.
